use IO.Std.read_line
use IO.Std.write
use IO.Std.write_line

// Seeded, so the transcript below reproduces.
let random = System.Random(11)

let low = 1
let high = 100

let target = random.next(low, high + 1)

write_line("I am thinking of a number between {low} and {high}.")

do
    write("Your guess: ")

    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        write_line()
        write_line("No more guesses.")

        break
    fi

    let guess mut = 0

    if !int.try_parse(line, guess ref) \/ guess < low \/ guess > high then
        write_line("That is not a number between {low} and {high}.")

        continue
    fi

    if guess < target then
        write_line("Too low.")
    elif guess > target then
        write_line("Too high.")
    else
        write_line("Well guessed!")

        break
    fi
